title: 第05章 叶黑 我呸权限狗第06章 万灵朝拜两个时间线的区别
slug: 遮天刚成天帝聊天群什么鬼
content_zh:
地球。
作为新一代三好青年。
叶凡在校园里也算是一个传奇人物。
哪怕从大学毕业步入社会，他也依旧混的风生水起，年纪轻轻便自主创业并且取得了不小的成就，二十来岁就开着一辆奔驰，成为人生赢家……
但，
叶凡觉得这样的生活有些无趣了。
他开始研究起了上古事迹，对于远古时代的那些传闻渐渐生出兴趣。
“先秦练气士！”
“世间真的有修炼者吗？”
叶凡的手中捧着一本道德经仔细阅读。
他时常都在思考这个问题。
世界上——
真的存在仙人吗！？
【叮！】
就在这时。
耳边突然传来一道轻响。
“嗯！？”
叶凡微微一愣。
他左顾右看的打量了一圈，结果没看见，便以为自己幻听了，随即放下手中的道经就准备起身离开。
然而，

就在这时。
那一道轻响声再次响起。
【叮！】
【群聊‘相亲相爱一家人’邀您进群！】
【请问是否同意？】
叶凡的耳边响起一道神秘的声音。
紧接着。
只见一道虚幻的画面出现在眼前。
“？？？”
叶凡有些愣神。
他下意识的揉了揉眼睛。
但眼前的虚幻面板依旧直挺挺的浮现在眼前。
“群聊？！”
叶凡有些震撼的喃喃道。
他当然知道这是什么东西，毕竟是新一代三号青年，网络小说什么的肯定没少看。
“难道……”
“世上真的有仙！？”
叶凡的内心忍不住激动了起来。
他下意识道：“同意！”
【叮！】

【您已同意入群！】
content_en:
Earth.
As a new generation of three good young people.
Ye Fan is also considered a legend on campus.
Even after graduating from college and entering the society, he was still prosperous. He started his own business at a young age and made great achievements. He drove a Mercedes-Benz in his twenties and became a winner in life...
But,
Ye Fan felt that such a life was a bit boring.
He began to study ancient deeds, and gradually became interested in the rumors of ancient times.
"Pre-Qin Qi Practitioner!"
"Are there really practitioners in the world?"
Ye Fan held a copy of the Tao Te Ching in his hand and read it carefully.
He often thinks about this problem.
In the world——
Do immortals really exist? ?
【bite! 】
Just then.
Suddenly there was a soft sound in my ears.
"Huh!?"
Ye Fan was slightly stunned.
He looked around, but when he didn't see it, he thought he was hallucinating. He immediately put down the Taoist Scriptures in his hand and prepared to get up and leave.
However,
Just then.
The soft sound sounded again.
【bite! 】
[Group chat ‘Love each other as a family’ invites you to join the group! 】
[Do you agree? 】
A mysterious voice sounded in Ye Fan's ears.
Immediately afterwards.
I saw an illusory picture appearing in front of my eyes.
"???"
Ye Fan was a little stunned.
He rubbed his eyes subconsciously.
But the illusory panel in front of him still appeared straight in front of his eyes.
"Group chat?!"
Ye Fan murmured in shock.
Of course he knew what it was. After all, he was a new generation of young man No. 3, and he must have read a lot of online novels.
"Could it be..."
"There are really immortals in the world!?"
Ye Fan couldn't help but feel excited.
He subconsciously said: "Agree!"
[Ding! 】
【You have agreed to join the group! 】
